rationale.edition: All ten changed paths live under web/src/ (the openobserve frontend tree): ViewPanel, ViewDashboard, PinnedDashboardTab, metrics/Index, and RUM AppPerformance. None sit under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or any o2-enterprise-owned path, so this is an OSS change. The code does reference config.isEnterprise to gate the query-Cancel button, but that is an OSS-hosted gating flag, not enterprise-owned code — the paths decide it as oss.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. The change rewires user-facing toolbar controls (Refresh and Cancel buttons) across several real views, so it is not docs/CI/comment-only. The trigger comment is empty and no tests-added label was passed, so there is no explicit opt-out.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The diff turns icon-only Refresh buttons into labelled ones and swaps the enterprise Cancel-query button to a labelled cancel-query variant, changing variants (outline/ghost-warning to primary/warning), sizes, mobile vs desktop icon/label behaviour, and tooltip enablement across dashboard panels, the dashboard header, the pinned-dashboard tab, the metrics add-panel toolbar, and the RUM performance view. These are user-visible interaction and state changes worth verifying.
rationale.area: Dashboards. The bulk of the UI changes live in dashboard components — ViewPanel.vue, ViewDashboard.vue, and PinnedDashboardTab.vue — with the metrics Index.vue and RUM AppPerformance.vue changes being sibling toolbar refactors of the same pattern. Dashboards is where the core component (ViewPanel) lives and where the E2E spec belongs.
rationale.group: Dashboards is the closest existing ci-matrix shard for a dashboard-toolbar spec; the change is centred on the dashboard view panel. The OSS ci_matrix.json is not present in this repo (only the enterprise overlay and cloud/env variants are), so the Engineer should confirm the exact testfolder name against ci_matrix.json.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The changed test files are Vitest unit specs under web/src/** (*.spec.ts: ViewPanel.spec.ts, viewDashboard.timeRange.spec.ts, PinnedDashboardTab.spec.ts, AppAnalytics.spec.ts, AppPerformance.spec.ts), which are unit coverage, not Playwright E2E — so existing_tests_in_diff is false and the Architect should author the E2E spec fresh.
